defaults.brandBaseline: Shpitto AI media baseline: #f5f1eb editorial canvas, #f16a3f coral primary, #e8dcff violet creative accent, dark studio surfaces, Avenir/system sans with semantic component states
defaults.tokenContract: All token values are canonical in src/config/brand.ts. CSS consumes the runtime projection and scoped semantic aliases; do not duplicate numeric token tables or literal :root fallbacks. The brand baseline is descriptive, not a second token source.
defaults.logoTreatment: Preserve customer logo artwork and colors on a light backing in the dark shell; do not invert or recolor the logo with filters.

sampleArtwork.contract: Use descriptive alt text where informative. Do not present sample artwork as a user's output, a live provider result or evidence of shipped image generation.

defaults.contract: The Shpitto brand tokens, logo and shared shell are template fallback defaults only. A customer delivery must replace the brand assets and/or tokens through the customization Skills; protected journeys remain unchanged.

accessibility: visible focus on light and dark surfaces
WCAG AA text contrast: 4.5:1 normal text and 3:1 large text

themes.contract: Remap existing semantic roles to studio CSS variables within the shared .site-shell-workspace so shared forms, text, borders, focus and status feedback inherit the dark theme. Avoid dashboard-only fixes and per-route palettes. Dark marketing media previews remain locally scoped.

generation.contract: The shipped runtime is video only. Image input is not image generation. Image-generator visual ambition must not appear as active image-generation tabs, supported APIs or shipped capability claims. Only expose runtime-supported model settings; presentation changes do not enable live providers or new modes.

requirements.marketing: Demonstrate end-user creative value with truthful copy, metadata and previews. Keep template purchasing, code ownership and engineering guidance in buyer documentation, outside customer creation, sign-in and billing flows.
requirements.workspaceNavigation: Preserve the selected workspace in creation, history, assets, team, billing and settings links, including header/footer actions. Use the shared navigation contract and encoded workspace identifiers without changing selection or membership checks.
